product.name: Relay (example)
product.description: Team messaging across phones and the web.

tests.title: An emoji reaction syncs across devices
tests.expect: The same emoji and the same count show on every device in the thread.

tests.title: Sending a message shows it optimistically
tests.expect: The message appears at once with a pending clock, then a single check within 2 seconds.

templates.name: Monthly regression — fresh install
templates.description: Two phones, clean install, the QA accounts.

flows.name: Messaging across two devices
flows.precondition: Relay installed on both phones, signed in as qa-1 (Pixel 8) and qa-2 (iPhone 13).

steps.text: Watch the message as it sends.
steps.expect: It appears at once with a pending clock, then a single check.
